verdict.bulk_fit: Excellent in the bulk: empirical mean D² = 4.000 (χ²(4) = 4.000); median Δ = -0.038.
verdict.tail_behaviour: Mildly HEAVIER than χ²(4): variance excess +6.5% (empirical var 8.524 vs 8.000); p99.9 quantile 20.00 vs χ²(4) 18.47 (Δ +1.54). χ²(4) therefore mildly UNDERSTATES p in the p99–p99.99 band (anti-conservative there).
verdict.headline_robustness: The minority's D² = 32.67 exceeds the empirical maximum over all 1,010,000 plans (max D² = 27.74); 0 plans reach it. Its outlier status is therefore empirically unambiguous and independent of the χ²(4) calibration. The published headline already carries two conservative hedges against the heavy tail: the n_eff Hotelling-F p (1.73×10⁻⁶) and the Bonferroni 2× bound (2.80×10⁻⁶); a tail mildly heavier than χ²(4) is absorbed well within that margin.
